articles.summary: Red Sift cut through 437 product use cases by building every demo around just one, chosen from real discovery instead of trying to show everything. That focus grew a more qualified pipeline, sped up proof-of-concept setup, and now works in analyst presentations too.
articles.title: Customer Show + Tell: How Red Sift Turns 437 Use Cases Into Demos that Close Deals

articles.title: The Evolution of Demo Software and Future with Agents
